objective: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.

description: If you return to the graveyard, <name>, you will find a gravestone there... Not just any gravestone; this one will stand out from the others. Secrets lie within it.
Push on the stone, and you will learn of these secrets...
progress: This must be the gravestone that Gaeriyan mentioned...
completion: You push on the stone firmly, and it slides away, revealing a small depression underneath it.
Placing Linken's Sword into the depression, you realize that it fits perfectly...
